text:
kai: Quick sync proposal — let's standardize a single request identifier and a simple sampling signal so Console dashboards can reliably join logs <-> traces. Suggest header/gRPC-metadata: `x-rw-request-id` (UUID), `x-rw-sample-rate` (float 0-1). Runtime should surface `request_id`, `trace_id`, and `sampled` to request-level logs. Need infra + runtime + console coordination for rollout. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on a single canonical header. We do need a gRPC metadata equivalent (same key) for Dedicated/on-prem. Also: should the sampling header be advisory only (server decides), or authoritative?

dylan: We already accept request-id in a few services but not consistently. Runtime changes are straightforward: attach request_id & trace_id to structured log events and add a boolean `sampled` field when we retain spans. For sampling control I'd prefer an advisory header — servers can ignore if it breaches policy. Maybe call it `x-rw-sampling-hint` and keep numeric `x-rw-sampling-priority` if you want tunable.

ashley: From Console/metrics side we need these fields in the ingress dataset so dashboards can join to traces. We can't keep full trace payloads for all requests, so store `request_id`, `trace_id`, `sampled` (bool), `sample_rate` (float) in the request log table. UX: expose a "Request ID" column and a trace-link that opens the tracing UI when `sampled=true`. Default sample coverage should be small (0.1%) to limit storage & cardinality issues.

kai: Agreed on default 0.1% (0.001) as a safe starting point. Rollout plan: gate runtime header propagation behind a feature flag `prop_request_id_v2` so we can ramp per-service. Also we should version the header if we need changes later (e.g., `x-rw-request-id-v2`).

infra-bot: deploy: runtime-instrumentation/staging build queued (#4567).

dylan: One big caution: adding request_id as a tag on high-cardinality metrics will blow up metrics storage. We should NOT add request_id as a label on counters/histograms. Instead: (1) store request_id in logs, (2) add a low-cardinality boolean `has_request_id` and `is_sampled` for aggregation, (3) provide one-off join paths for debugging flows in Console.

maria: Good call. Also security note: request IDs must not leak PII. Ensure middleware generates IDs when absent and doesn't echo user input. For gRPC, add middleware to copy `x-rw-request-id` -> `request-id` in context, and fall back to generated UUID.

ashley: Data schema change needed. Proposed schema additions to request logs: `request_id` (string, nullable), `trace_id` (string, nullable), `sampled` (bool), `sample_rate` (float). I'll open a dashboard-schema PR that adds example queries and a "Trace coverage" panel to surface sample-rate over time. Also will add a migration note so old dashboards don't break (treat nulls as not-sampled).

kai: Quotas: sampling headers must not be an escape hatch for quotas. We should enforce server-side caps and ignore client-supplied sample_rate when client is trying to increase sampling beyond tenant cap. Also track a metric `sampling_override_attempts` for audit.

metrics-bot: metric created: `platform.request_logs.trace_coverage` (summary) — initial retention: 90d.

dylan: Implementation tasks I see: 1) runtime middleware to normalize header & grpc metadata, 2) attach fields to structured logs, 3) wire sampling decision logic (server side, with optional advisory header), 4) add flag for per-service rollout. I'll open runtime PR and link.

maria: I'll add gRPC interceptor and update Dedicated docs for operator-managed deployments. Will include examples for env var fallback and how to disable sampling in air-gapped setups.

ashley: Console tasks: 1) schema PR for request logs, 2) new panels + trace-link UX, 3) rollout checklist & feature-flag toggle in Console so SRE/products can toggle per-tenant. I'll create tickets.

kai: Nice. Next actions + owners: dylan (runtime PR + sampling logic), maria (grpc middleware + docs), ashley (schema + dashboard PR + UX), kai (feature flag plan + rollout schedule). Target: staging deploy next week, canary week after, full ramp over 2 weeks. :thumbsup:

kai: Also question for SRE/infra — can we add a lightweight span-export for sampled requests to our tracing backend (only for sampled=true)? That keeps storage bounded.

dylan: Yes, plan is to export spans only when `sampled=true`. We'll include a short span summary + link to full trace viewer.

ashley: I'll add a Dashboard NOTE: metric joins will be best-effort for non-sampled requests. We'll add a "trace coverage" metric to indicate how many requests are sampled so teams understand visibility.

kai: Great — thanks everyone. I'll file the umbrella RFC and link the individual PRs. Ping me for blockers. :eyes:
